1283-2440-4347-7850.notablePrerequisites: You control three or more Griffins.
1283-2440-4347-7850.description:
Cast Misthollow Griffin by paying {4}.
When Misthollow Griffin enters, Mirror of Life Trapping and Mana Echoes trigger.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Griffin you control.
Resolve the Mirror of Life Trapping trigger, exiling Misthollow Griffin.
Repeat.

1325-5170-6132-8249.description:
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Metamorphosis Fanatic.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic dies, Kheru Bloodsucker triggers, causing you to gain 2 life and each opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Activate Defiant Salvager by sacrificing Junji.
When Junji dies, it and Kheru Bloodsucker trigger.
Resolve the Kheru Bloodsucker trigger, causing you to gain 2 life and each opponent to lose 2 life
Resolve the Junji trigger, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from your graveyard to the battlefield and causing you to lose 2 life.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Junji from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Resolve the Defiant Salvager ability, putting a +1/+1 counter on Defiant Salvager
Repeat.

6566-8095--5--195.easyPrerequisites: At least one persist creature has any type of counter on it.
6566-8095--5--195.description:
Activate Hammerhead by sacrificing the persist creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
When that creature dies, its persist ability and Yuna trigger.
Resolve Yuna's ability, putting at least two +1/+1 counters onto the surviving persist creature due to the counter-increasing effect.
If that creature had a -1/-1 counter on it, remove that and one of the +1/+1 counters from it as a state-based action.
Resolve the persist ability from step 2, returning the persist creature from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter.
Resolve the Hammerhead ability from step 1.
Repeat.

1170-4779-5131-7010--202.easyPrerequisites: You haven't cast an artifact spell using Muldrotha this turn.
1170-4779-5131-7010--202.notablePrerequisites: There are at least three Lesson cards in your graveyard.
1170-4779-5131-7010--202.description:
Cast the artifact from your graveyard using Muldrotha's ability by paying {0} due to Gran-Gran.

Resolve the artifact spell.
Activate Krark-Clan Grunt by sacrificing the artifact, giving Krark-Clan Grunt +1/+0 and first strike until end of turn
Repeat.

1362-1479-7892.description:
Play Oboro, Palace in the Clouds.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, it, Thranduil the Strategist, and Kodama of the East Tree trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, choosing not to put anything from your hand onto the battlefield.
Resolve the Oboro, Palace in the Clouds trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Thranduil the Strategist trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Oboro, Palace in the Clouds from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Oboro, Palace in the Clouds enters the battlefield, it and Thranduil the Strategist trigger.
Repeat from step 4.

1978-5527-7714.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two Clues.
1978-5527-7714.description:
Cast Five Hundred Year Diary by paying its mana cost.
When Five Hundred Year Diary enters, Ultron triggers, causing you to pay {2} to create a copy of Five Hundred Year Diary that is a 2/2 Robot Villain creature.
Put the nontoken Five Hundred Year Diary into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
During your next turn, activate the Five Hundred Year Diary token by tapping it, adding {U} for each Clue you control
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping the Five Hundred Year Diary token.
Repeat from step 4.

670-1619-6153-6966.notablePrerequisites: You are currently venturing in Tomb of Annihilation in the Trapped Entry room.
670-1619-6153-6966.description:
Cast All-Fates Stalker by paying its mana cost.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, causing Vicious Battlerager to be returned to the battlefield from exile.
When Vicious Battlerager enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the Vicious Battlerager trigger, venturing into the Cradle of the Death God room, creating a 4/4 legendary The Atropal creature token and completing Tomb of Annihilation.
If you control two or more The Atropal tokens, put all but one into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Sefris' second ability triggers, returning All-Fates Stalker from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it and Radiant Solar trigger.
Resolve the All-Fates Stalker trigger, exiling Vicious Battlerager until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 10, venturing into Tomb of Annihilation and into the Trapped Entry room, causing each player to lose 1 life.
Resolve the Radiant Solar trigger from step 6, venturing into the Oubliette room, causing you to discard a card and then sacrifice All-Fates Stalker.
Repeat from step 5.

3532-3536-5078-6792.easyPrerequisites: There is a removable counter on a creature you control.
3532-3536-5078-6792.description:
Declare Cheering Fanatic as an attacker. When it triggers, choose to name "Sensei's Divining Top".
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Mm'menon triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Mm'menon.
Repeat from step 2.

215-2404-7781.notablePrerequisites: You control at least six creatures.
215-2404-7781.description:
Activate Gaea's Cradle by tapping it, adding at least six {G}.
Cast Woodcaller Automaton for its prototype cost by paying {2}{G}{G}.
When Woodcaller Automaton enters, it triggers, causing Gaea's Cradle to become a creature and untapping it.
Activate Temur Sabertooth by paying {1}{G}, returning Woodcaller Automaton from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

Activate Phantom Train by sacrificing Scholar of New Horizons.
When Scholar of New Horizons dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to its replacement effect.
Resolve the Phantom Train ability.
Repeat.

Activate Lotus Field by tapping it, adding {G}{G}{G}.
Activate Ley Weaver by tapping it, untapping Wirewood Lodge and Lotus Field.
Activate Wirewood Lodge's second ability by paying {G} and tapping it, untapping Ley Weaver.
Repeat.

Activate Basalt Monolith's second ability by paying {2}, as its cost is reduced by Blossoming Tortoise, due to being a land because of Toph, untapping Basalt Monolith.
Repeat.

If Aether Spellbomb is in your graveyard, activate Emry by tapping it, targeting Aether Spellbomb.
Cast Aether Spellbomb either from your hand or from your graveyard by paying {0} due to Etherium Sculptor.
Mirran Spy triggers, untapping Emry.
Activate Urza's first ability by tapping Aether Spellbomb, adding {U}.
Activate Aether Spellbomb's second ability by paying {1} and sacrificing it, causing you to draw a card.
Repeat.

940-1438.easyPrerequisites:
Arcane Teachings attached to Eater of the Dead.
Eater of the Dead does not have summoning sickness.
940-1438.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Eater of the Dead deathtouch.
940-1438.description:
Give Eater of the Dead deathtouch by any method.
Activate Eater of the Dead by tapping it, dealing 1 damage to any nontoken creature an opponent controls.
The creature dies due to Eater of the Dead's deathtouch.
Activate Eater of the Dead by paying {0}, exiling the creature card from its owner's graveyard  and untapping Eater of the Dead.
Repeat.
You may also repeat this loop whenever a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

1734-2034-6132.description:
Cast Fiend Hunter by paying its mana cost.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Fiend Hunter.
When Fiend Hunter dies, its second ability triggers, returning Metamorphosis Fanatic from exile to the battlefield.
When Metamorphosis Fanatic enters, it triggers, returning Fiend Hunter from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Fiend Hunter enters, its first ability triggers, exiling Metamorphosis Fanatic.
Repeat from step 3.

Activate Crystalline Crawler's second ability by tapping it, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Arcbound Overseer.
When Arcbound Overseer dies, it triggers, putting its +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability five times by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Declare Alesha as an attacker, triggering its ability, targeting Arcbound Overseer.
Activate Crystalline Crawler's first ability twice by removing two +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W/B}{W/B}.
Resolve the Alesha trigger, causing you to pay {W/B}{W/B} to return Arcbound Overseer from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped and attacking with six +1/+1 counters on it due to its modular ability.
Repeat.

Activate Mine Worker by tapping it, causing you to gain life.
Archangel of Thune triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Activate Crystalline Crawler ability by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's ability by paying {U}, untapping Mine Worker.
Repeat.

2511-3020-6701.easyPrerequisites: An opponent has a creature card in their graveyard.
2511-3020-6701.description:
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Puppeteer Clique.
When Puppeteer Clique dies, its persist ability and Szarel trigger.
Resolve the persist trigger, returning Puppeteer Clique from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.

Resolve the Szarel trigger, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on another creature you control.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability from step 1.
Activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing the creature returned in step 4.
When the creature dies, Szarel triggers, putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Puppeteer Clique.
Resolve the Bloodflow Connoisseur ability.
Repeat.

325-602-5435-6282.easyPrerequisites: You have at least one card in hand.
325-602-5435-6282.description:
Activate Dream Trawler by discarding a card.
Toluz's second ability and Feast of Sanity trigger.
Resolve the Feast of Sanity trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Toluz trigger, exiling the discarded card from your graveyard.
Ketramose triggers, causing you to draw a card and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Dream Trawler ability.
Repeat.

567-3490-4050-6283.easyPrerequisites:
You have a way to gain life.
You have a nonland card on top of your library.
567-3490-4050-6283.notablePrerequisites: You have a way to give Soul's Attendant indestructible.
567-3490-4050-6283.description:
Gain life.
Amalia triggers, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Amalia triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
Resolve the Amalia trigger, revealing the top card of your library and then putting a +1/+1 counter on Amalia, putting the card back on top of your library, and destroying all other creatures if Amalia's power is 20.
Repeat from step 3.

277-730-1479-5700-5701.notablePrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
277-730-1479-5700-5701.description:
Play Petrified Field.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree and Emeria Angel trigger.
Resolve the Kodama of the East Tree trigger, putting nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Echoing Deeps from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Echoing Deeps from your hand onto the battlefield as a copy of Petrified Field.
When Echoing Deeps enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel and Tiller Engine trigger.
Resolve the Tiller Engine trigger, untapping Echoing Deeps.
Holding priority, activate Echoing Deeps using Petrified Field's second ability by tapping and sacrificing it, returning Petrified Field from your graveyard to your hand.
Resolve the Emeria Angel trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama of the East Tree triggers, putting Petrified Field from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Petrified Field enters the battlefield, Emeria Angel triggers.
Repeat from step 4.

222-527-4068-5231.notablePrerequisites:
You control at least one Mountain.
You control a Saproling.
222-527-4068-5231.description:
Activate Selvala by paying {G} and tapping it, adding at least {B}{G}{G}.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing Slimefoot and Squee and Selvala, adding {R}{R}.
Activate Slimefoot and Squee by paying {1}{B}{R}{G} and sacrificing a Saproling, returning it and Selvala from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Slimefoot and Squee enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating a 1/1 Saproling creature token.
Repeat.

Deal combat damage to an opponent using a Rogue
Cast Notorious Throng for its prowl cost by paying {5}{U}, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.

When the Revolutionist token enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Notorious Throng from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

549-1115-3259-5953.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
549-1115-3259-5953.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Aya of Alexandria trigger.
Resolve the Aya of Alexandria trigger, creating a 1/1 Assassin creature token.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the Assassin token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

3661-5852-5929.description:
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}, and choosing to pay its replicate cost an arbitrarily large number of times by paying {0}.
Shield Sphere triggers, creating a copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.
Resolve all Shield Sphere spells, causing the nontoken Shield Sphere to enter the battlefield, and creating a token copy of it for each time its replicate cost was paid.

236-1978-2585.description:
Animate Grim Monolith using Bring to Life.
Activate Grim Monolith by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}.
Activate Voltaic Construct by paying {2}, untapping Grim Monolith.

Elemental Mastery attached to Famished Paladin.
